title: Strong order one-half convergence of a coupled tamed Euler--Peano scheme for reflected stochastic differential equations with super-linearly growing coefficients
summary: We study strong numerical approximations for reflected stochastic differential equations in possibly unbounded convex domains with super-linearly growing drift and diffusion coefficients. Under a coupled monotonicity condition and polynomial local Lipschitz assumptions, we first establish the well-posedness of the reflected SDE and derive uniform moment bounds for its solution.
